description: Énergies renouvelables (i38) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Federal Planning Bureau. Definition: renewable energy is measured as the share of energy consumption from renewable sources in gross final energy consumption, as defined in the European Directive 2009/28/EC on the promotion of the use of energy from renewable sources (Official Journal of the European Union, 5/6/2009). Coverage: Federal Planning Bureau. The portal shows the English title as "Renewable energy (i38)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Federal Planning Bureau. Its keywords include G07_REN. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
